result:
No failures — pre-existing warnings are unrelated to this change. The fix is complete.

I fixed the missing authorization check in `PostController.destroy()` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts`), which previously deleted any post by id with no ownership check. It now calls `await this.authorize('delete', [Post, post])` before deleting, mirroring the pattern already used in `update()`/`edit()`; the `PostPolicy.delete()` method (which restricts deletion to the post's author) already existed but was never invoked. I added `tests/PostControllerDestroy.test.ts` covering: a non-author signed-in user gets 403 and the post survives, a guest is refused, and the author can still delete their own post. `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass, and `bunx guren check` shows no new issues.
